text: Experimental work by Pöppel and Fraisse established that the 'psychological present' — the window within which events are integrated into a single experienced 'now' — spans approximately ___ seconds.
explanation: The psychological (or specious) present spans roughly two to three seconds, a window that appears consistent across cultures and sensory modalities and shows up in spontaneous rhythmic tapping, speech phrasing, and musical grouping. It is far longer than the roughly 25-millisecond gamma cycle (the elementary perceptual unit) and far shorter than the twenty-to-thirty-second span over which working memory decays.
